server.eval_image_contract: Eval clients must explicitly choose image count and order. The server does not infer or reorder camera views from training config.

eva.initial_qpos_source: median first state of the 100 training episodes, excluding 9 validation episodes; rad

observation_source: recorded state/images at issued-action count; no command-conditioned physics
timing_scope: recorded trigger frames decoded before pacing; includes on-thread synthetic PNG publication and mock servo; not robot throughput
